segments.text: Remake version of the character from the original featured in the Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-. Unofficial twenty eighth of The Twenty-seven Dead Apostle Ancestors and former priest of the Holy Church, the Dead Apostle Arcueid is searching for.
Noel is an Executor of the Holy Church trained to kill vampires posing as a teacher at Metropolitan Souya High School. In Ciel's route, she becomes a vampire before she is killed.
A younger version of Arcueid.

Neco-Arc is a member of the NEKO Spirit race, originating from the Great Cat's Village. It's either a materialization of TATARI or the guest from another world brought here by Zelretch, as well as the mascot character of Type-Moon.
She speaks with the catlike accent and likes to play on the nerves of others. Even her appearance frightens certain characters.
Present in Tsukihime Remake, but only in After Bad End scenes.

Shiki is a kind, honest, if not slightly playful second-year high school student. He is anemic and is prone to fainting, but he tries his best to live a normal life. He has the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, allowing him to see the "Lines" and "Points" that enable him to kill all things using the highly effective assassination techniques hidden in his subconscious. Despite being constantly surrounded by death he has a greater appreciation for life than most people and would never take a human life.

cast.originalCharacterName: アルクェイド・ブリュンスタッド

segments.text: Known for her iconic beauty, carefree attitude, and overwhelming strength, Arcueid appears as a stunning young woman with pale skin, golden eyes, and distinctive, almost ethereal blond hair. Beneath her charming personality lies a lethal existence: a near-immortal True Ancestor created to eradicate Dead Apostles and preserve the balance among supernatural beings.

In the remake, Arcueid’s character is fleshed out with more nuanced motivations and emotional depth. Though she initially approaches Tohno Shiki with vengeance in mind after he fatally wounds her, their encounters reveal her complex nature—torn between her purpose as a True Ancestor and her longing for freedom and human experiences. Despite her deadly nature and near-limitless power, Arcueid exhibits an innocent curiosity about the world, often expressing delight in simple pleasures, though she struggles with the violent impulses ingrained in her existence as a vampire.
Ciel is a senior attending the same school as Shiki, where she is the president and only member of the tea ceremony club, and also good friends with Inui, Satsuki and Shiki himself.
Her outward demeanor is that of a calm, friendly, and peaceful person.
Edited from Wikipedia
Actual age: 25
Physical age: 18

Akiha is the adoptive younger sister of Shiki. Born into the prestigious Toono family, Akiha lived a sheltered childhood. Thanks to Shiki she was able to experience at least some semblance of the joys of childhood. Unfortunately not soon afterwards, Shiki was near-fatally wounded in an accident and was sent by Makihisa to live with the Arimas, relatives from another branch of the family. Contact was made impossible when Akiha was placed in a boarding school and she was forced to live on campus. Upon the death of their father eight years later, Akiha became the head of the Toono household and, ignoring protests from the remaining relatives, called Shiki back to live at the family mansion with her. Akiha is very protective of her brother. She is always intent on knowing what he does with his day, and is extremely suspicious of what he does at night. She gets incredibly jealous when he is around other girls.

The older of the two twin maids in the Toono mansion, Kohaku, along with her sister Hisui, is a childhood friend of Shiki. She wears a Japanese kimono and always seems to be smiling and cheerful. She was trained in brewing herbal remedies and poisons, being especially gifted with medicine.

Hisui is the twin sister of Kohaku. She fills the role of cleaning maid to the Toono household. Always wearing her western maid uniform, Hisui can frequently be found tidying up the lobby, dusting the rooms of the mansion or waiting for Shiki to return at the gates.
Shiki's classmate and friend, who likes him very much. She is shy and has somewhat of an inferiority complex. She has a crush on Shiki, although he is slowing realizing how he feels about her.
Noel is an Executor of the Holy Church trained to kill vampires posing as a teacher at Metropolitan Souya High School. In Ciel's route, she becomes a vampire before she is killed.

The one who gave Shiki the "Mystic-eye-killer glasses" (which she stole from her sister) to prevent him from seeing the lines of death. She is also the one who taught Shiki to value living things, whether it be humans, animals, or even plants. She is shown to have a bright cheerful personality that reacts very strongly to careless actions.
